title: Signal: Yarn lockfile pins an absolute registry URL
scope: A yarn.lock file that declares a resolution that hard-codes a registry tarball URL instead of a version range.
limitations: It matches a resolution that hard-codes a registry tarball URL instead of a version range in the parsed yarn.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A yarn.lock that mentions a resolution that hard-codes a registry tarball URL instead of a version range in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
